aggregation_contract: Average annotator variants within observation/model first; give each observation equal weight; all differences are selected-policy minus V35.

scope.locked_role: retrospective transfer diagnostic only; prior S0 analyses already inspected this block, so it is not an independent holdout

development_threshold_contract.objective: maximize spine_coverage mean difference vs V35

mask_only.model: class-weighted logistic regression; three-fold development OOF probabilities; full-development refit for locked prediction

mask_plus_context.model: class-weighted logistic regression; three-fold development OOF probabilities; full-development refit for locked prediction

mde_reference.interpretation: A policy mean below this value is not automatically useless; this is an approximate detectability reference, not an operational margin.

limitations: Oracle policies use ground truth and are non-deployable ceilings.
Observable gates require running both V35 and V42 before selection.
The gate acts at observation level and cannot establish proposal-level S1 value.
Threshold scanning makes development performance optimistic.
Locked results are retrospective because the block was inspected previously.
pq_512 is an observation-level proxy, not official 2048-pixel micro PQ.
No S1 model, registration margin, GPU training, or review-derived label is used.
